limits: Simulation does not establish enjoyment, brand comprehension or desire to start another batch.
0.1 manual delivery policy has different timing/approval/brand setup; only0.2 adapter pairs isolate dispatch operations under identical demand.
Age12 all prices can sit at16 floor; later taste/age/price gates can prevent specialist and department demand. No hidden retuning.
Finite seeded orders are hypothetical store behavior. Shared caps and policy-dependent starvation do not establish a universally best priority.
Declaring a direction and learning a shipment profile alter bounded expectation factors, never the actual whiskey or a quality score. No prohibition on changing recipes.
Learning observes actual shipped quantity only; empty releases/offers/acceptance/propagation train nothing.
No automatic production/bottling, persistent backlog, main retail sale or native brand-economy integration.
Known, offered, approved, handling, demand, shipment and revenue remain distinct. Zero stock can leave known approved stores without sales.
